feed.title: XRIA Lab
feed.subtitle: XRIA Lab: eXtended Reality and Industrial & Intelligent Analytics for Human-Centered Industrial Systems. We develop AI-driven extended reality, simulation, and decision-support systems that make manufacturing safer, smarter, and more sustainable.

entry.title: XRIA Lab joins the RESILIENT Competence Centre with FLEXIVA

link.title: XRIA Lab joins the RESILIENT Competence Centre with FLEXIVA

entry.content:
Together with Scania and the USER – Uppsala Smart Energy Research group, XRIA Lab is joining the extension of the RESILIENT Competence Centre for Resilient Energy Systems for 2027–2031.

Our project, FLEXIVA, tackles the barriers to industrial energy flexibility: where the flexibility potential lies in production, what it takes to provide it within operational constraints, and when it makes economic sense. FLEXIVA will recruit a postdoctoral researcher; see Join Us.

entry.title: MANUFACTOR kicks off, our first Horizon Europe project

link.title: MANUFACTOR kicks off, our first Horizon Europe project

entry.content:
The Horizon Europe project MANUFACTOR starts today and runs until April 2029. XRIA Lab joins 13 partners across Europe to build a multi-agent platform that combines XR, multi-agent AI, human digital twins, and multimodal sensing for cognitive and physical augmentation of industrial operators and managers.

entry.title: Two new Vinnova projects start, ARTISAN and AI-COMPETE

link.title: Two new Vinnova projects start, ARTISAN and AI-COMPETE

entry.content:
XRIA Lab starts two new three-year projects funded by Sweden’s Innovation Agency (Vinnova).

ARTISAN develops agentic XR training that captures expert knowledge and guides new operators on the shop floor, together with AugmentedRealm, Hitachi Energy, Solme, and Ekets Group.

AI-COMPETE develops a multi-agent AI decision-support system that aligns production planning with renewable energy availability, together with the University of Skövde, Volvo Penta, Scania, Daloc AB, and Evoma AB.

At the same time, the education project PUMA2025 starts, bringing XR into machine design teaching at Uppsala University.
